item.title: FWP Announces CRP Add-on Lease Enrollment Period
item.description: Agricultural producers with land enrolled in the federal Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) are invited to apply for Montana Fish, Wildlife & Park’s CRP Add-on Lease. item.title: Montana Livestock Loss Board Announces Livestock Loss Prevention Grant Recipients

item.title: Colorado Parks & Wildlife Commission Advances Fur Sale Ban Petition
item.description: On March 4, the Colorado Parks and Wildlife Commission voted, by a count of 6-4, to move a proposed fur ban forward into the rulemaking phase.
